_comment: Ambiguous extensions and their disambiguation, feature 070 FR-006. Every extension here resolves to 'default' unless the named rule's probe matches; the probes are implemented in src/plugins/codeview/intake.cpp (CvProbe*) and each is a test case in the harness. Source: specs/070-source-viewer-plugin/research/language-detection.md S3.

h-header.probe: Objective-C markers (@interface / @implementation / #import <Foundation) -> objective-c; a C-only marker set with no C++ token -> c; otherwise C++.

m-source.probe: MATLAB markers (a leading 'function [' / '%%' cell marker and no @interface) -> matlab-plain; otherwise Objective-C.

pl-script.probe: A Prolog clause (':-' at the start of a line) with no Perl sigil line -> prolog.

ts-source.probe: '<TS ' or '<!DOCTYPE TS' in the first bytes -> Qt translation XML; the MPEG transport-stream signature (0x47 at 188-byte stride) is caught by the binary rule before this.

inc-include.probe: '<?php' -> PHP; a leading assembler directive -> asm; C/C++ preprocessor lines -> cpp; otherwise plain.

sql-dialect.probe: 'DECLARE @' or 'GO' batch separators -> T-SQL flavour; PL/SQL 'CREATE OR REPLACE PACKAGE' -> plsql.

cls-file.probe: '\\documentclass' or '\\NeedsTeXFormat' -> LaTeX class; 'VERSION 1.0 CLASS' -> VB class; 'public with sharing class' -> Apex.

t-test.probe: 'use strict' / 'use Test' -> Perl test; 'unit ' -> Turing; otherwise Perl.

asm-source.probe: '.include' / '.globl' / 'section .text' -> assembler; a leading '#' comment block with 'riscv' -> riscv.
